summary: Master climate finance for public institutions with practical tools for screening, structuring, and reporting climate investments.
lede: Climate finance training helps public institutions and development teams assess, structure and track funding for mitigation, adaptation and resilience. It is for professionals working with budgets, project documents, funding proposals or donor reporting, and covers climate opportunity screening, concept-note drafting, climate risk assessment, blended-finance design, safeguards and reporting dashboards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with budgets, project documents, funding proposals, or donor reporting and need a stronger climate finance capability.
modules: Climate Finance Architecture and Public Mandates
Monitoring Reporting and Climate Finance Strategy
prerequisites: You need a laptop, spreadsheet software, and the ability to review sample budgets, project briefs, and funding templates. Familiarity with public sector planning, donor-funded programmes, or investment appraisal will help you apply the exercises more effectively.
